note_title: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题

callouts.id: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题#1
callouts.title: 有限测度空间上依照测度收敛的充要条件
callouts.body: 在***有限测度***空间上，函数列$X_n$是一列可测函数，那么$X_n \xrightarrow{\mu}{X}$等价于任意子列$X_{n(m)}$都存在一个子列的之列$X_{n(m_k)}$几乎处处收敛到$X$

classification_result.id: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题#1
classification_result.english_title: Necessary and Sufficient Condition for Convergence in Measure on a Finite Measure Space

if_problem.statement_en: On a finite measure space, let $X_n$ be a sequence of measurable functions. Then $X_n \xrightarrow{\mu} X$ if and only if for every subsequence $X_{n(m)}$, there exists a further subsequence $X_{n(m_k)}$ that converges to $X$ almost everywhere.
key_techniques: almost everywhere convergence versus convergence in measure

callouts.id: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题#2
callouts.title: Urysohn subsequence principle
callouts.body: 如果$y_n$属于拓扑空间当中的集合，并且任意子列$y_{n(m)}$都存在一个收敛到拓扑空间当中元素$y$的子列$y_{n(m_k)}\to y$，那么$y_n\to y$.

classification_result.id: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题#2

if_problem.statement_en: Let $y_n$ be a sequence in a topological space. If every subsequence $y_{n(m)}$ has a further subsequence $y_{n(m_k)}$ converging to an element $y$ of the space, then $y_n \to y$.

callouts.id: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题#3
callouts.title: 反例1
callouts.body: 假设命题成立不需要测度空间是有限的，那么在实数的Lebesgue测度空间上考虑函数列$f_n(x):=(x+1/n)^2$。这个函数列处处收敛到$x^2$,因此它的子列以及子列的子列都是处处收敛到$x^2$的。但是这个序列并不依Lebesgue测度收敛到$x^2$，因为对充分小的$\varepsilon$$$\{x\in \mathbb{R}:(x+1/n)^2-x^2\geq \varepsilon\}=[\frac{n\varepsilon}{2}-\frac{n}{2},+\infty)$$对任意的$n\in \mathbb{N}$而言这个集合的测度都是无穷的。因此该序列不会依测度收敛到$x^2$,这就与命题矛盾了。

classification_result.id: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题#3

if_problem.statement_en: Assume the previous equivalence were true without requiring the measure space to be finite. On $(\mathbb{R}, \text{Lebesgue measure})$, consider $f_n(x) := (x+1/n)^2$. Then $f_n(x) \to x^2$ for every $x$, so every subsequence and every further subsequence also converges pointwise to $x^2$. However, $f_n$ does not converge to $x^2$ in Lebesgue measure, because for sufficiently small $\varepsilon$, $$\{x \in \mathbb{R} : (x+1/n)^2 - x^2 \geq \varepsilon\} = [\tfrac{n\varepsilon}{2} - \tfrac{n}{2}, +\infty),$$ and this set has infinite measure for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$. Hence the sequence does not converge to $x^2$ in measure, contradicting the claimed extension.
key_techniques: construction on an infinite measure space

callouts.id: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题#4
callouts.title: 问题
callouts.body: 对于连续函数$f:\mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}$的连续映射，$X_n$是概率空间当中的一列随机变量，那么$X_n$在什么条件下的收敛可以使得$f(X_n)$保持这种收敛性？

classification_result.id: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题#4

callouts.id: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题#5
callouts.title: 依照概率收敛在连续映射下保持不变
callouts.body:
假设$f:\mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}$是一个连续映射，那么
$$X_n(\omega)\xrightarrow {\text{P}}X(\omega) \implies f(X_n) \xrightarrow {P}{f(X)}$$

classification_result.id: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题#5
classification_result.english_title: Convergence in Probability Is Preserved Under Continuous Mappings

if_problem.statement_en: Assume $f:\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ is continuous. Then $$X_n \xrightarrow{\mathrm{P}} X \implies f(X_n) \xrightarrow{\mathrm{P}} f(X).$$
key_techniques: control of inverse images under continuity
